limitations: Small sequential sample, not a performance or reliability benchmark.

The first reused guest later became unresponsive after passing the relay test. Chrome was blocked in folio_wait_writeback through ext4_evict_inode and overlayfs teardown. New browser connections and guest-agent exec also timed out. Cause not isolated; state-preservation assertions passing does not imply guest lifecycle reliability.
An initial 30-second snapshot request timeout left the first guest paused and required explicit resume. The experiment now allows 120 seconds for lifecycle HTTP requests.
Pending commands and WebSocket ping behavior were tested, but semantic browser idleness, migration, arbitrary packet loss, multi-client behavior, and long-run stability were not.
